This extension manages <syntaxhighlight lang="html" inline><spoiler></syntaxhighlight> tags in spoiler buttons.


== Features ==

* Turns <syntaxhighlight lang="html" inline><spoiler></syntaxhighlight> in spoiler buttons
* Dynamic Show/Hide / Display/Conceal actions
* "Back to spoiler's top" link when the spoiler is of a certain height


== Installation ==

* Unzip the directory to {{hl|wiki/extensions/BIKISpoiler}}
* Add <syntaxhighlight lang="php" inline>wfLoadExtension( 'BIKISpoiler' );</syntaxhighlight> to {{hl|LocalSettings.php}}
